description: Discrete piecewise-flat fillings of S^1 (length 2*pi): minimize Heron area over intrinsic edge lengths subject to strict triangle inequalities, boundary cone angles >= pi, and d(b_i, b_j) >= d_S1(b_i, b_j). Two-ring boundary collar (4 faces per boundary vertex); multi-restart Powell -> adaptive Nelder-Mead on a penalized objective (k = 5 Steiner graph); feasibility restoration and certification on a k = 16 Steiner graph plus the exact corner-cut lower bound.
